sources.entry: Brackets - Modern open-source code editor for HTML, CSS and JavaScript that's built in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

summary.one_liner: Brackets is an open-source code editor for HTML, CSS and JavaScript that is itself built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, now in maintenance mode.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Brackets as a modern open-source code editor for HTML, CSS and JavaScript, built using those same web technologies. It states that active development has moved to the Phoenix Code Project, so this repository only accepts security patches. New features and bug fixes are directed to the Phoenix Code repository. The README gives contact channels (a Matrix room, a Discord server, and a subreddit) and notes a Contributor Code of Conduct. It does not describe specific editor features, install steps, or platform details.
use_cases: editing HTML, CSS and JavaScript files
browsing and studying a web-built editor codebase
notable: Editor itself is written in HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Active development has moved to Phoenix Code Project
Repository is in maintenance mode, accepting only security patches
Community contact via Matrix, Discord and Reddit
caveats: Maintenance mode: no new features or regular bug fixes here
Feature and contribution work should go to the Phoenix Code repository
README contains no install or build instructions
